# IProtocolAccessManagerV2
[Git Source](https://github.com/OasisDEX/summer-earn-protocol/blob/main/packages/access-contracts/src/interfaces/IProtocolAccessManagerV2.sol)

**Title:**
IProtocolAccessManagerV2

Public surface of `ProtocolAccessManagerV2`. Extends the V1 manager with a per-context
whitelist and a contract-specific Operator role used by institutional Fleet variants.


## Functions
### grantOperatorRole

Grants the contract-specific Operator role for `fleetCommanderAddress` to `account`.

Despite the parameter name, the Operator role is scoped to any contract that exposes
`hasOperatorRole(account)` against itself — typically a Fleet, but also AdmiralsQuarters
and the rounds vaults. Inheriting contracts (via `ProtocolAccessManagedV2`) use the role
to let trusted bundler/proxy contracts bypass user-side gateways. Restricted to the
Governor role.


```solidity
function grantOperatorRole(address fleetCommanderAddress, address account) external;
```
**Parameters**

|Name|Type|Description|
|----|----|-----------|
|`fleetCommanderAddress`|`address`|The contract the Operator role is scoped to (typically a Fleet)|
|`account`|`address`|The account to grant the role to|


### revokeOperatorRole

Revokes the contract-specific Operator role for `fleetCommanderAddress` from `account`.

Despite the parameter name, the Operator role is contract-scoped — it applies to any
contract that exposes `hasOperatorRole(account)` against itself (see
`ProtocolAccessManagedV2`), not just Fleets. Restricted to the Governor role.


```solidity
function revokeOperatorRole(address fleetCommanderAddress, address account) external;
```
**Parameters**

|Name|Type|Description|
|----|----|-----------|
|`fleetCommanderAddress`|`address`|The contract the Operator role is scoped to (typically a Fleet)|
|`account`|`address`|The account to revoke the role from|


### grantWhitelistManagerRole

Grants `WHITELIST_MANAGER_ROLE` to `account`.

Whitelist managers may call `setWhitelisted`, `setWhitelistedBatch`, and
`setWhitelistOpen`. Restricted to the Governor role.


```solidity
function grantWhitelistManagerRole(address account) external;
```
**Parameters**

|Name|Type|Description|
|----|----|-----------|
|`account`|`address`|The account to grant the role to.|


### revokeWhitelistManagerRole

Revokes `WHITELIST_MANAGER_ROLE` from `account`.

Restricted to the Governor role.


```solidity
function revokeWhitelistManagerRole(address account) external;
```
**Parameters**

|Name|Type|Description|
|----|----|-----------|
|`account`|`address`|The account to revoke the role from.|


### isWhitelisted

Returns whether `account` is allowed to interact with `context`.


```solidity
function isWhitelisted(address context, address account) external view returns (bool);
```
**Parameters**

|Name|Type|Description|
|----|----|-----------|
|`context`|`address`|The context (typically a Fleet address) the check is scoped to|
|`account`|`address`|The account to check|

**Returns**

|Name|Type|Description|
|----|----|-----------|
|`<none>`|`bool`|`true` when either `context`'s whitelist is globally open or `account` has an explicit whitelist record for `context`.|


### areWhitelisted

Batch variant of `isWhitelisted`: returns the per-account status array under a single
load of the `_isWhitelistOpen[context]` flag.


```solidity
function areWhitelisted(address context, address[] calldata accounts) external view returns (bool[] memory);
```
**Parameters**

|Name|Type|Description|
|----|----|-----------|
|`context`|`address`|The context the check is scoped to|
|`accounts`|`address[]`|Accounts to check|

**Returns**

|Name|Type|Description|
|----|----|-----------|
|`<none>`|`bool[]`|statuses Array of statuses aligned with `accounts`.|


### isWhitelistOpen

Returns whether `context`'s whitelist has been globally opened.


```solidity
function isWhitelistOpen(address context) external view returns (bool);
```
**Parameters**

|Name|Type|Description|
|----|----|-----------|
|`context`|`address`|The context to check|

**Returns**

|Name|Type|Description|
|----|----|-----------|
|`<none>`|`bool`|True if `context`'s whitelist is globally open.|


### setWhitelisted

Sets `account`'s explicit whitelist record for `context`.

Idempotent — no event is emitted when the status is unchanged. Restricted to
`WHITELIST_MANAGER_ROLE`.


```solidity
function setWhitelisted(address context, address account, bool allowed) external;
```
**Parameters**

|Name|Type|Description|
|----|----|-----------|
|`context`|`address`|The context the record is scoped to|
|`account`|`address`|The account to update|
|`allowed`|`bool`|The new status (`true` for whitelisted, `false` to remove the record).|


### setWhitelistedBatch

Batch variant of `setWhitelisted`. Reverts on length mismatch or when the batch
exceeds `MAX_WHITELIST_BATCH_SIZE`. Restricted to `WHITELIST_MANAGER_ROLE`.


```solidity
function setWhitelistedBatch(address context, address[] calldata accounts, bool[] calldata allowed) external;
```
**Parameters**

|Name|Type|Description|
|----|----|-----------|
|`context`|`address`|The context the records are scoped to|
|`accounts`|`address[]`|Accounts to update|
|`allowed`|`bool[]`|Per-account statuses, aligned with `accounts`|


### setWhitelistOpen

Sets the global-open flag for `context`. When `true`, every account reads as
whitelisted for `context`. Restricted to `WHITELIST_MANAGER_ROLE`.


```solidity
function setWhitelistOpen(address context, bool isOpen) external;
```
**Parameters**

|Name|Type|Description|
|----|----|-----------|
|`context`|`address`|The context to update|
|`isOpen`|`bool`|The new open status|


## Events
### WhitelistStatusUpdated
Emitted when an account's explicit whitelist record for `context` changes.


```solidity
event WhitelistStatusUpdated(address indexed context, address indexed account, bool isWhitelisted);
```

**Parameters**

|Name|Type|Description|
|----|----|-----------|
|`context`|`address`|The context (e.g. a Fleet address) the status is scoped to|
|`account`|`address`|The account whose status changed|
|`isWhitelisted`|`bool`|The new status (`true` for whitelisted, `false` for removed)|

### WhitelistOpenUpdated
Emitted when the global-open flag for `context` changes.


```solidity
event WhitelistOpenUpdated(address indexed context, bool isOpen);
```

**Parameters**

|Name|Type|Description|
|----|----|-----------|
|`context`|`address`|The context the flag is scoped to|
|`isOpen`|`bool`|`true` if every account now reads as whitelisted for `context`|

## Errors
### Whitelist_LengthMismatch
Reverts when `setWhitelistedBatch` is called with mismatched `accounts` and
`allowed` array lengths.


```solidity
error Whitelist_LengthMismatch();
```

### Whitelist_BatchTooLarge
Reverts when `setWhitelistedBatch` is called with more accounts than
`MAX_WHITELIST_BATCH_SIZE` (currently 200).


```solidity
error Whitelist_BatchTooLarge();
```
